payload.blocks: Phase 2 (argv window) of plan 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner, and phases 3, 6 and 7 behind it.
payload.headline: Your cargo/node answer cannot go in project config (args are global-only): which route instead?

parts.cause: Executor args are x-fgos-scope: global-only in core/config-schema/runner.schema.yaml (security rule: a project file may not change what command a worker runs), and lists are leaves, so the --allowedTools flags can only live in the machine's global ~/.fgos/config.yaml, which confined heads cannot write.

options.does: The lead reruns the phase 2 unit pinned to the standard invocation claude-herdr-bypass-bwrap (bwrap with private home, isolated session, own worktree; permission bypass), through fgos run --override. No config change.
options.gain: No hand from you, no standing permission change; that invocation already exists for exactly this case.
options.harm: Inside that cage the worker may run any tool, not only cargo/node. If --override cannot pin an invocation, the lead asks again.
options.label: Lead pins the existing full-confinement bypass invocation

options.cost: One command from you; one rerun.
options.does: You run once: fgos config patch --global with the claude-cli-bwrap args plus --allowedTools 'Bash(cargo:*)' 'Bash(node:*)' 'Bash(npm test:*)'; the supervisor can hand you the exact patch file.
options.gain: Narrow tool list; every later Rust unit on this machine passes.
options.harm: Applies to every project on this machine; needs you at the keyboard once.
options.label: You add --allowedTools in the global config

options.does: Phase 2 waits for plan 261124-1853-confinement-to-rust, which loosens the cage for the role's own work.
options.label: Park phase 2

parts.recommendation: Option 1: it applies your 'let claude workers run cargo' intent with no hand from you and no standing change, using an invocation the standard already confines fully; option 2 is the fallback if the pin is refused.

scope.allows: One rerun of the phase 2 unit with the chosen route (option 1: pinned claude-herdr-bypass-bwrap; option 2: your one global config patch).
scope.forbids: Any change to confinement policies, project executor args, git write grants for workers, other phases or the plan's scope.

parts.what: You chose 'allow cargo and node for claude workers in project config' (q-qzcq5xti2k). The supervisor tried it: fgos config patch of runner.executors.claude.invocations into .fgos/config.yaml was refused, config-key-out-of-scope belongs-in=global. Nothing was written. Phase 1 is landed (719331230); phase 2 waits.
